Based on my search of the project history, the final name of the enum type introduced to replace the boolean `isTimestamped`/`isHeadersEnabled` parameters on the DslParams constructors is `DslStoreFormat`.

This enum was specified in the KIP-1285 proposal for DSL opt-in support for header-aware state stores. The voting phase started on 2026-02-20, and the implementation (PR #21572) was opened on 2026-02-24, establishing `DslStoreFormat` as the agreed-upon enum approach for cleaner parameter passing to replace the boolean parameters.
